value.title: Battle of Jarnac
value.snippet: of Jarnac on 13 March 1569 was an encounter during the French Wars of Religion between the Catholic forces of Marshal Gaspard de Saulx, sieur de Tavannes

value.title: Jarnac
value.snippet: and about 10 km east of and Cognac. It was the site of the Battle of Jarnac in 1569. The region has long been associated with the production of cognac.
